items.meaningZh: 联系紧密、互相帮助的社区
items.meaningEn: a community where people know and support each other
items.example: I grew up in a tight-knit community where everyone helped each other out.
items.exampleZh: 我在一个联系紧密的社区长大，邻里之间都会互相帮忙。

items.meaningEn: very close, a short distance away
items.example: My old school is just a stone's throw away from my parents' house.
items.exampleZh: 我的母校离我父母家只有一步之遥。

items.meaningEn: an area where neighbours know and help one another
items.example: I live in a close-knit neighbourhood where people stop to chat in the street.
items.exampleZh: 我住在一个关系紧密的社区，人们会在街上停下来聊天。

items.meaningEn: the lively atmosphere created by people and activity nearby
items.example: I love the local buzz around the new market because it makes my town feel alive.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢新市场带来的本地热闹气氛，它让我的小镇充满活力。

items.meaningEn: away from the usual tourist routes
items.example: I stayed in a village off the beaten track, where tourists rarely go.
items.exampleZh: 我住在一个远离常规路线的村庄，那里很少有游客去。

items.term: like the back of my hand
items.meaningEn: very familiar with a place
items.example: I know the old town like the back of my hand after living here for years.
items.exampleZh: 在这里住了多年，我对老城区了如指掌。

items.meaningEn: something refreshing and pleasantly different
items.example: I find the weekend market a breath of fresh air compared with my usual shopping centre.
items.exampleZh: 与平常的购物中心相比，我觉得周末市场让人耳目一新。

items.term: what I like most about it is
items.phonetic: /ˌwɒt aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈməʊst əˈbaʊt ɪt ɪz/
items.meaningEn: the feature I appreciate most is
items.example: What I like most about it is the slow pace of life and the friendly people.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜欢它的一点是缓慢的生活节奏和友好的人们。

items.term: it's got a real sense of
items.meaningEn: it has a strong feeling of
items.example: It's got a real sense of history, and I can feel it as I walk around.
items.exampleZh: 它有一种真正的历史感，你走着就能感受到。

items.term: you won't find anywhere quite like it
items.phonetic: /ju ˌwəʊnt ˈfaɪnd ˌenɪweə ˌkwaɪt ˈlaɪk ɪt/
items.meaningZh: 你找不到和它完全一样的地方
items.meaningEn: it is unique and hard to match
items.example: I promise you won't find anywhere quite like it because the whole town feels like a family.
items.exampleZh: 我保证你找不到和它完全一样的地方，因为整个小镇就像一个大家庭。

items.meaningEn: used to introduce a frank opinion
items.example: To be honest, I didn't appreciate my hometown until I moved away.
items.exampleZh: 说实话，直到搬走我才懂得欣赏我的家乡。

items.meaningEn: used to add a contrasting point
items.example: Having said that, the traffic in my hometown has become much worse.
items.exampleZh: 话虽如此，我家乡的交通已经变得差多了。

items.meaningEn: a regular office job with fixed hours
items.example: I don't want a nine-to-five job because I'd rather have flexible hours.
items.exampleZh: 我不想要朝九晚五的工作，因为我更希望有灵活的时间。

items.meaningEn: cope with a demanding, deadline-driven situation
items.example: I can work under pressure, but I prefer to have a clear plan.
items.exampleZh: 我在压力下工作得不错，尤其是截止日期临近的时候。

items.meaningEn: a period when you have to learn a lot quickly
items.example: Starting my new course was a steep learning curve, but I enjoyed the challenge.
items.exampleZh: 开始新课程的学习曲线很陡，但我喜欢这个挑战。

items.meaningEn: move up to more senior jobs
items.example: I'd like to climb the career ladder without letting work take over my life.
items.exampleZh: 我想在职业上步步高升，但不想让工作占据我的生活。

items.meaningEn: memorise something word for word
items.example: At school we had to learn by heart long poems, which I actually enjoyed.
items.exampleZh: 在学校我们得背下长诗，我其实还挺喜欢的。

items.meaningEn: begin to understand or handle something
items.example: It took me a while to get to grips with the software at work.
items.exampleZh: 我花了一段时间才熟练掌握工作上的软件。

items.meaningEn: work or study late into the night
items.example: I used to burn the midnight oil before every exam, which left me exhausted.
items.exampleZh: 我以前每次考试前都熬夜，结果累得不行。

items.meaningEn: I care deeply about
items.example: I'm really passionate about teaching because I love seeing students improve.
items.exampleZh: 我真的很热爱教学，因为我喜欢看到学生进步。

items.term: it gives me a sense of achievement
items.phonetic: /ɪt ˌɡɪvz mi ə ˌsens əv əˈtʃiːvmənt/
items.meaningEn: it makes me feel I have accomplished something
items.example: It gives me a sense of achievement when I finally solve a tricky problem.
items.exampleZh: 当我最终解决一个棘手的问题时，我会有成就感。

items.meaningEn: I have always been attracted to
items.example: I've always been drawn to jobs where I can work with people.
items.exampleZh: 我一直被能和人们打交道的工作吸引。

items.meaningEn: used to give a candid opinion
items.example: If I'm honest, I chose this course mainly because it sounded interesting.
items.exampleZh: 说实话，我选这门课主要是因为它听起来有趣。

items.meaningEn: used to introduce the real issue
items.example: The thing is, I enjoy the theory but the exams stress me out.
items.exampleZh: 问题是，我喜欢理论，但考试让我压力很大。

items.meaningEn: a small, warm and comfortable apartment
items.example: I live in a cosy little flat near the city centre with my sister.
items.exampleZh: 我和姐姐住在市中心附近一间温馨的小公寓里。

items.meaningEn: a lot of daylight coming in
items.example: My favourite room has plenty of natural light, which makes it feel welcoming.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的房间自然光充足，让人觉得很温馨。

items.meaningEn: a design with few internal walls
items.example: I love the open-plan layout because the kitchen and living room feel like one space.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢开放式布局，因为厨房和客厅感觉像一个空间。

items.meaningEn: close enough to reach on foot
items.example: Everything I need is within walking distance, so I hardly use my car.
items.exampleZh: 我需要的一切都在步行范围内，所以我几乎不用车。

items.meaningZh: 第二个家；像家一样的地方
items.meaningEn: a place that feels as comfortable as home
items.example: My grandmother's house has always been a home away from home for me.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶家一直是我的第二个家。

items.meaningEn: become comfortable in a new place
items.example: It took me a few weeks to settle in after moving to a new city.
items.exampleZh: 搬到新城市后，我花了几个星期才安顿下来。

items.meaningEn: have just enough money to cover basic costs
items.example: I had to take a second job just to make ends meet last year.
items.exampleZh: 去年我不得不打第二份工才能勉强维持生计。

items.meaningEn: it feels comfortable and familiar
items.example: As soon as I walk in, it feels like home because of the warm colours.
items.exampleZh: 一进门就有家的感觉，因为颜色很温暖。

items.term: the best part about it is
items.meaningEn: its most enjoyable feature is
items.example: The best part about it is the balcony, where I have my morning coffee.
items.exampleZh: 它最好的地方是阳台，我早上会在那里喝咖啡。

items.term: I couldn't imagine living anywhere else
items.meaningEn: I would not want to live anywhere else
items.example: I've been here for years now and I couldn't imagine living anywhere else.
items.exampleZh: 我在这里住了好多年了，无法想象住在别处。

items.meaningEn: in my opinion
items.example: As I see it, a home should be comfortable rather than perfectly stylish.
items.exampleZh: 在我看来，家应该舒适，而不是多么时尚。

items.meaningEn: in my view
items.example: If you ask me, location matters more than having a huge living room.
items.exampleZh: 依我看，位置比拥有一个大客厅更重要。

items.meaningEn: get a quick, casual meal
items.example: I usually grab a bite near the office because my lunch break is short.
items.exampleZh: 我通常在公司附近随便吃点，因为午休时间很短。

items.meaningEn: food prepared at home
items.example: I think nothing beats a home-cooked meal after a long day at work.
items.exampleZh: 我觉得辛苦一天后，没有什么比得上一顿家常饭。

items.meaningEn: a diet with the right mix of nutrients
items.example: I try to keep a balanced diet, but I do love the occasional takeaway.
items.exampleZh: 我尽量保持均衡饮食，但我确实偶尔爱吃外卖。

items.meaningEn: someone who is very selective about food
items.example: My brother is a fussy eater, so we always let him choose the restaurant.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟很挑食，所以我们总是让他选餐厅。

items.meaningEn: eat a large amount
items.example: I eat like a horse after the gym, so I always cook a big dinner.
items.exampleZh: 健身之后我食量很大，所以我总会做一顿丰盛的晚餐。

items.meaningEn: love sugary food
items.example: I have a sweet tooth, so I can never resist dessert after dinner.
items.exampleZh: 我爱吃甜食，所以晚饭后总是忍不住吃甜点。

items.term: bite off more than I can chew
items.phonetic: /ˌbaɪt ɒf ˈmɔː ðən aɪ kən ˈtʃuː/
items.meaningEn: take on more than I can handle
items.example: I always bite off more than I can chew when I plan a dinner party.
items.exampleZh: 我计划晚宴时总是贪多嚼不烂。

items.meaningEn: I like something very much
items.example: I'm a big fan of spicy food, especially Sichuan hotpot.
items.exampleZh: 我非常喜欢辛辣食物，尤其是四川火锅。

items.meaningEn: it is a special pleasure
items.example: We only order sushi occasionally, so it's a real treat when we do.
items.exampleZh: 我们只是偶尔点寿司，所以每次吃都像一种难得的享受。

items.meaningEn: that is a safe, reliable choice
items.example: I'd say you can't go wrong with a bowl of noodles if you want something simple.
items.exampleZh: 如果你想吃点简单的，我觉得来碗面准没错。

items.meaningEn: to express it in plain terms
items.example: To put it simply, I'd rather eat at home than wait in a queue.
items.exampleZh: 简单来说，我宁愿在家吃也不想排队。

items.meaningEn: used to give a hesitant opinion
items.example: I suppose I eat out more now because I'm too busy to cook.
items.exampleZh: 我想我现在更常出去吃，因为我太忙没时间做饭。

items.meaningEn: raining heavily
items.example: It was pouring with rain this morning, so I took a taxi to work.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上大雨倾盆，所以我打车去上班。

items.meaningEn: a short period of unusually hot weather
items.example: We had a bit of a heatwave last summer, and nobody could sleep.
items.exampleZh: 去年夏天有点热浪，谁都睡不好。

items.meaningEn: bright weather with no clouds
items.example: I love autumn because we get clear blue skies without the summer crowds.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢秋天，因为我们有晴朗的蓝天，又没有夏天的拥挤。

items.meaningEn: weather that is never very hot or very cold
items.example: I love the south because it has a mild climate and rarely gets too hot.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢南方，因为那里气候温和，很少太热。

items.meaningEn: extremely happy
items.example: I was on cloud nine when the sun finally came out after a week of rain.
items.exampleZh: 经过一周的雨天，太阳终于出来时我欣喜若狂。

items.meaningEn: feeling slightly ill
items.example: I've been feeling a bit under the weather since the temperature dropped.
items.exampleZh: 气温下降后，我一直觉得有点不舒服。

items.meaningEn: whatever the weather or circumstances
items.example: I go for a run every morning, come rain or shine.
items.exampleZh: 我每天早上都去跑步，风雨无阻。

items.term: I'm not a big fan of
items.meaningEn: I do not like something much
items.example: I'm not a big fan of humid weather because it makes me feel tired.
items.exampleZh: 我不太喜欢潮湿的天气，因为它让我觉得累。

items.meaningEn: the conditions are ideal for
items.example: It's perfect weather for a picnic, so I'm heading to the park.
items.exampleZh: 这样的天气正适合野餐，所以我要去公园。

items.meaningEn: it is impossible to know in advance
items.example: I find you can never predict the weather here, so I always carry an umbrella.
items.exampleZh: 我发现这里的天气永远无法预料，所以我总带着伞。

items.meaningEn: used to explain or soften what you say
items.example: I mean, I enjoy the snow, but the ice on the roads is dangerous.
items.exampleZh: 我是说，我喜欢雪，但路上的冰很危险。

items.meaningEn: used to add a balanced view
items.example: To be fair, I love the summers here, even if the winters drag on.
items.exampleZh: 公平地说，我喜欢这里的夏天，即使冬天很漫长。

items.meaningEn: start doing a hobby
items.example: I decided to take up a hobby that would get me away from screens.
items.exampleZh: 我决定培养一项能让我远离屏幕的爱好。

items.meaningEn: relax after work
items.example: I go for a swim to unwind after work, even when I'm tired.
items.exampleZh: 下班后我会去游泳放松，即使很累也去。

items.meaningEn: become addicted to something
items.example: I get hooked on new hobbies easily, so I try to choose cheap ones.
items.exampleZh: 一个朋友带我去室内攀岩馆后，我就迷上了攀岩。

items.term: a great way to switch off
items.meaningEn: a good way to stop thinking about work
items.example: I find gardening is a great way to switch off after a busy day.
items.exampleZh: 我觉得园艺是忙碌一天后放松的好方式。

items.term: kill two birds with one stone
items.meaningEn: achieve two things with one action
items.example: I cycle to work, so I kill two birds with one stone: exercise and commuting.
items.exampleZh: 我骑车上班，这样一举两得：锻炼和通勤。

items.meaningEn: relax and enjoy myself
items.example: At the weekend I like to let my hair down and dance with friends.
items.exampleZh: 周末我喜欢放松一下，和朋友们跳舞。

items.meaningEn: completely comfortable and confident
items.example: When I'm cooking for friends, I'm in my element and totally relaxed.
items.exampleZh: 给朋友做饭时，我如鱼得水，完全放松。

items.term: I've got into the habit of
items.meaningEn: I have started doing something regularly
items.example: I've got into the habit of reading for twenty minutes before bed.
items.exampleZh: 我养成了睡前读二十分钟书的习惯。

items.term: it helps me clear my head
items.meaningEn: it helps me think clearly and relax
items.example: I go running in the park because it helps me clear my head.
items.exampleZh: 我去公园跑步，因为这能帮我理清思绪。

items.term: there's nothing I enjoy more than
items.meaningEn: this is my favourite thing to do
items.example: There's nothing I enjoy more than a long walk in the countryside.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜欢做的事就是在乡间长时间散步。

items.meaningEn: in my opinion
items.example: The way I see it, hobbies are just as important as work.
items.exampleZh: 在我看来，爱好和工作一样重要。

items.meaningEn: usually
items.example: More often than not, I spend my free time at home rather than going out.
items.exampleZh: 我多半待在家里，而不是出去玩。

items.meaningEn: a tune that is easy to remember
items.example: The song has a catchy tune, and I found myself humming it all day.
items.exampleZh: 这首歌旋律朗朗上口，我一整天都在哼。

items.meaningEn: music played quietly while doing something else
items.example: I put on background music while I study, but only instrumental tracks.
items.exampleZh: 我学习时会放背景音乐，但只听纯音乐。

items.meaningEn: music performed in front of an audience
items.example: I love live music because the energy in a small venue is amazing.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢现场音乐，因为小场地里的气氛特别棒。

items.meaningEn: something you only start to like after repeated exposure
items.example: Jazz was an acquired taste for me, but now I listen to it daily.
items.exampleZh: 爵士乐对我来说是慢慢才喜欢上的，但现在我每天都听。

items.meaningEn: create exactly the right mood or effect
items.example: I think the playlist hit the right note for a relaxed dinner party.
items.exampleZh: 我觉得这个歌单为一顿轻松的晚餐定对了基调。

items.meaningEn: something very pleasant to hear
items.example: Hearing my favourite song on the radio is music to my ears.
items.exampleZh: 在收音机里听到我最喜欢的歌，真是悦耳。

items.meaningEn: decide what to do as things happen
items.example: We usually play it by ear when we go on a road trip.
items.exampleZh: 我们去公路旅行时通常见机行事。

items.meaningEn: I am very enthusiastic about
items.example: I'm really into indie music at the moment, especially bands from Manchester.
items.exampleZh: 我现在非常喜欢独立音乐，尤其是曼彻斯特的乐队。

items.meaningEn: it reminds me of
items.example: It takes me back to my school days whenever I hear that song.
items.exampleZh: 每次听到那首歌，它都让我回想起学生时代。

items.meaningEn: I cannot stop myself from joining in
items.example: Whenever that chorus comes on, I can't help singing along.
items.exampleZh: 每当副歌响起，我都忍不住跟着唱。

items.meaningEn: speaking for myself
items.example: For me personally, music is a way to relax after a stressful day.
items.exampleZh: 对我个人而言，音乐是压力一天后放松的方式。

items.meaningEn: for that reason
items.example: I grew up around musicians, and that's why I love playing the guitar.
items.exampleZh: 我在音乐人身边长大，所以我很喜欢弹吉他。

items.meaningEn: an exciting story that holds your attention
items.example: The film has a gripping plot, so I stayed up until two in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 这部电影情节扣人心弦，所以我熬到凌晨两点。

items.meaningZh: 让人想一口气看完的剧
items.meaningEn: a show you want to watch episode after episode
items.example: It's a binge-worthy series, and I finished the whole season in one weekend.
items.exampleZh: 这是一部让人想一口气看完的剧，我一个周末就看完了整季。

items.meaningEn: visual tricks used in films
items.example: I thought the special effects were impressive, but the story felt a bit weak.
items.exampleZh: 我觉得特效很震撼，但故事有点弱。

items.meaningEn: a person or thing everyone knows
items.example: That actor is a household name now, though I remember her in tiny roles.
items.exampleZh: 那位演员现在家喻户晓，但我还记得她演小角色的时候。

items.meaningZh: 电视迷；总窝在沙发上看电视的人
items.meaningEn: someone who spends a lot of time watching TV
items.example: I become a couch potato at weekends and watch old comedies for hours.
items.exampleZh: 我周末会变成电视迷，连看几个小时老喜剧。

items.term: on the edge of my seat
items.meaningEn: very excited and anxious about what happens next
items.example: During the final episode I was on the edge of my seat the whole time.
items.exampleZh: 看最后一集时，我全程都紧张地屏住呼吸。

items.meaningEn: try something
items.example: I wasn't sure about the show, but I decided to give it a go.
items.exampleZh: 我一开始不确定这节目，但还是决定试一试。

items.meaningEn: enjoy something so much you want more
items.example: I can't get enough of crime dramas at the moment, especially British ones.
items.exampleZh: 我现在对犯罪剧百看不厌，尤其是英国的。

items.meaningEn: it deserves to be watched
items.example: Even though I'm not into sci-fi, I think it's well worth watching for the visuals.
items.exampleZh: 虽然我不太喜欢科幻，但我觉得它很值得为视觉效果一看。

items.term: the ending completely blew me away
items.meaningEn: the ending amazed me
items.example: The ending completely blew me away, and I sat there in silence.
items.exampleZh: 结局完全震撼了我，我坐在那里一言不发。

items.meaningEn: used to introduce a contrasting point
items.example: Saying that, I still prefer going to the cinema to watching at home.
items.exampleZh: 话虽如此，我还是更喜欢去电影院而不是在家看。

items.meaningEn: in my opinion
items.example: I'd say comedies are my favourite because they help me switch off.
items.exampleZh: 我会说喜剧是我的最爱，因为它们帮我放松。

items.meaningEn: a book that is very exciting to read
items.example: The novel was such a page-turner that I finished it in two days.
items.exampleZh: 这本小说太引人入胜了，我两天就看完了。

items.meaningEn: sit comfortably and read
items.example: On rainy Sundays I love to curl up with a book and a cup of tea.
items.exampleZh: 下雨的星期天，我喜欢蜷着看书，喝杯茶。

items.meaningEn: a large variety of
items.example: I use the library because it offers a wide range of books, from thrillers to history.
items.exampleZh: 我利用图书馆，因为它有各种各样的书，从惊悚小说到历史。

items.meaningEn: become fully absorbed in a story
items.example: I read before bed because I can lose myself in a story and forget my worries.
items.exampleZh: 我睡前读书，因为我能沉浸在故事里，忘掉烦恼。

items.meaningEn: understand the hidden meaning
items.example: When I read the email, I could read between the lines and sense bad news.
items.exampleZh: 读那封邮件时，我能读懂言外之意，感觉到坏消息。

items.meaningEn: someone who loves reading
items.example: I was a bookworm as a child and spent every break in the library.
items.exampleZh: 我小时候是个书虫，每个课间都待在图书馆。

items.meaningEn: start behaving in a better way
items.example: I've decided to turn over a new leaf and read for half an hour each day.
items.exampleZh: 我决定改过自新，每天读半小时书。

items.meaningEn: I read a lot
items.example: I'm a big reader, though I mostly choose fiction rather than non-fiction.
items.exampleZh: 我很爱读书，不过我大多选小说而不是非虚构。

items.meaningEn: it is difficult to stop reading
items.example: Once I start a good thriller, it's hard to put down until the last page.
items.exampleZh: 一旦开始一本好的惊悚小说，就很难放下，直到最后一页。

items.meaningEn: I think everyone should read it
items.example: It's a brilliant memoir, and I'd recommend it to anyone.
items.exampleZh: 这是一本很棒的回忆录，我会向任何人推荐它。

items.meaningEn: speaking completely truthfully
items.example: In all honesty, I read more online articles than actual books these days.
items.exampleZh: 说实话，我现在读的网上文章比实体书还多。

items.term: the way I look at it
items.meaningEn: in my opinion
items.example: The way I look at it, reading is a cheap way to travel without leaving home.
items.exampleZh: 在我看来，阅读是一种不用离家就能旅行的廉价方式。

items.meaningEn: compare prices in different shops
items.example: I always shop around before buying a laptop because prices vary so much.
items.exampleZh: 我买笔记本电脑前总是货比三家，因为价格差别很大。

items.meaningEn: someone who looks for good deals
items.example: I'm a bargain hunter, so I never buy anything at full price.
items.exampleZh: 我爱淘便宜货，所以从不原价买东西。

items.meaningEn: something bought suddenly without planning
items.example: That fancy coffee machine was an impulse buy, and I barely use it.
items.exampleZh: 那台高级咖啡机是我一时冲动买的，我几乎不用它。

items.meaningEn: looking at shops without buying
items.example: I enjoy window shopping, even when I have no intention of buying anything.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢只逛不买，即使完全没打算买东西。

items.term: cost an arm and a leg
items.meaningEn: be extremely expensive
items.example: Those designer trainers cost an arm and a leg, so I waited for the sale.
items.exampleZh: 那双名牌运动鞋贵得要命，所以我等到打折才买。

items.meaningZh: 宰人的东西；太贵的东西
items.meaningEn: something that is much too expensive
items.example: The drinks at that concert were a complete rip-off, so we left early.
items.exampleZh: 那场演唱会的饮料完全是宰人，所以我们早早离开了。

items.meaningEn: be very expensive
items.example: I didn't buy the coat because it would have cost a fortune.
items.exampleZh: 我没买那件外套，因为它会花一大笔钱。

items.meaningEn: I am only looking, not ready to buy
items.example: When an assistant asks if I need help, I usually say I'm just browsing.
items.exampleZh: 店员问我要不要帮忙时，我通常说我只是随便看看。

items.meaningEn: it was an excellent bargain
items.example: I bought the coat in the sale, and it was a real steal.
items.exampleZh: 我在打折时买了那件外套，真是捡了个大便宜。

items.meaningEn: I usually choose
items.example: I tend to go for simple designs rather than flashy logos.
items.exampleZh: 我倾向于选择简单的设计，而不是花哨的标志。

items.meaningEn: to speak honestly
items.example: To be frank, I'd rather save my money than buy more clothes.
items.exampleZh: 坦率地说，我宁愿存钱也不愿多买衣服。

items.meaningEn: used to add a contrasting point
items.example: I like the local shops, mind you, they're often packed at weekends.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢当地的商店，不过话说回来，周末通常很挤。

items.meaningEn: a trip you are unlikely ever to repeat
items.example: Seeing the northern lights was a once-in-a-lifetime trip, and I'd do it again.
items.exampleZh: 看到北极光是一生一次的旅行，我还想再去。

items.meaningEn: take very little luggage
items.example: I always travel light, so I only take a small backpack.
items.exampleZh: 我总是轻装出行，所以只带一个小背包。

items.meaningZh: 远离一切；摆脱日常压力
items.meaningEn: escape from daily routine and stress
items.example: I go to the mountains to get away from it all for a few days.
items.exampleZh: 我去山里待几天，远离一切。

items.meaningEn: a wonderful place that few people know about
items.example: I found a little fishing village that was a hidden gem, with hardly any tourists.
items.exampleZh: 我发现一个小渔村，那是个鲜为人知的宝地，几乎没有游客。

items.meaningEn: adapt to events without a fixed plan
items.example: I don't plan every detail, I prefer to go with the flow when I travel.
items.exampleZh: 我不会计划每个细节，旅行时更喜欢顺其自然。

items.meaningEn: start a journey
items.example: We usually hit the road early to avoid the traffic.
items.exampleZh: 我们通常早早出发，避开交通拥堵。

items.meaningEn: extremely slowly
items.example: The traffic was moving at a snail's pace, so we missed our train.
items.exampleZh: 车流以极其缓慢的速度移动，所以我们错过了火车。

items.meaningEn: it was stunningly beautiful
items.example: It was absolutely breathtaking when we reached the top of the mountain.
items.exampleZh: 当我们到达山顶时，那真是美得令人窒息。

items.term: I'd go back in a heartbeat
items.meaningEn: I would return immediately
items.example: I loved Lisbon, and I'd go back in a heartbeat.
items.exampleZh: 我很喜欢里斯本，我会立刻回去。

items.meaningEn: the thing I noticed most was
items.example: What struck me most was how friendly everyone was, even in busy areas.
items.exampleZh: 最让我印象深刻的是每个人都很友好，即使在繁忙地区。

items.meaningEn: in my opinion
items.example: As far as I'm concerned, travelling is about experiences, not souvenirs.
items.exampleZh: 就我而言，旅行重在体验，而不是纪念品。

items.meaningEn: in addition
items.example: I chose the hotel because it was cheap, and on top of that, breakfast was included.
items.exampleZh: 我选这家酒店是因为它便宜，而且除此之外，早餐还包含在内。

items.meaningEn: easy to use
items.example: The app is really user-friendly, so even my grandparents can use it.
items.exampleZh: 这个应用非常易于使用，连我祖父母都会用。

items.meaningEn: something that changes a situation radically
items.example: For me, smartphones were a game-changer because they keep me in touch with family.
items.exampleZh: 对我来说，智能手机改变了格局，因为它们让我和家人保持联系。

items.meaningEn: good at using technology
items.example: My little brother is incredibly tech-savvy, so he fixes all my devices.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟非常精通科技，所以他会修我所有的设备。

items.meaningEn: time spent looking at a phone or computer screen
items.example: I try to limit my screen time in the evening so I can sleep better.
items.exampleZh: 我尽量在晚上限制屏幕使用时间，以便睡得更好。

items.meaningEn: something with both benefits and drawbacks
items.example: For me, social media is a double-edged sword because it saves time but distracts me.
items.exampleZh: 对我来说，社交媒体是一把双刃剑，因为它省时间，但也让我分心。

items.meaningEn: the most advanced
items.example: I love cutting-edge gadgets, but I wait until the price drops.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢最前沿的小玩意，但我会等价格降下来。

items.meaningEn: unable to stop looking at my phone
items.example: I'm glued to my phone on the train, even when I could read instead.
items.exampleZh: 我在火车上总是盯着手机，即使本可以看书。

items.meaningZh: 我无法想象没有……的生活
items.meaningEn: I rely completely on
items.example: I can't imagine life without my phone, which sounds a bit sad.
items.exampleZh: 我无法想象没有手机的生活，这听起来有点可悲。

items.term: it saves me a lot of time
items.phonetic: /ɪt ˌseɪvz mi ə ˈlɒt əv ˈtaɪm/
items.meaningEn: it makes me more efficient
items.example: Online banking is convenient because it saves me a lot of time.
items.exampleZh: 网上银行很方便，因为它帮我节省很多时间。

items.meaningEn: my main purpose for using it is
items.example: I use it mainly for work, though I do watch videos too.
items.exampleZh: 我主要用它来工作，不过我也会看视频。

items.meaningEn: used to add a contrasting thought
items.example: Then again, technology can be distracting when I'm trying to study.
items.exampleZh: 不过话说回来，我想学习的时候，科技会让人分心。

items.meaningEn: used to suggest a stronger or opposite point
items.example: If anything, I spend too much time online, so I take regular breaks.
items.exampleZh: 要说的话，我上网时间太多了，所以我定期休息。
